// Fixture: the BFF opening its own database connection. Forbidden by invariant 15 and this repo's
// AGENTS.md — data belongs to the context that owns it, and the BFF reaches it over gRPC. A direct
// query here also bypasses RLS and the PDP, so it breaks tenancy and authorization at once
// (invariants 1, 2).
package handler

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

func Repositories(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	_, err := pool.Query(ctx, "select id from repositories")
	return err
}
